title: Smoky Paella Semolina Bites
description: A twist on traditional Japanese snacks, these bite-sized Paella Semolina treats infuse smoky flavors with a warm, comforting twist.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine semolina flour and paella rice.
3. Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
5. Divide the dough into small balls and flatten slightly.
6. Heat safflower oil in a skillet over medium heat.
7. Cook the semolina bites for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
8. Remove from heat and sprinkle with smoked paprika.
